en: Welcome!\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nfabulous prizes next door.
Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!\pDo you need some game COINS?\nWould you like to buy some?
No?\nPlease come play sometime!
Oh, I'm sorry.\nYou don't have a COIN CASE.
Whoops!\nYour COIN CASE is full.
You can't afford the COINS.
Thank you.\nHere are your COINS!
Keep this quiet.\pIt's rumored that this place is run\nby TEAM ROCKET.
I think these machines have\ndifferent odds.
Kid, do you want to play?
{PLAYER} received 10 COINS\nfrom the man.
You don't need my COINS!
Wins seem to come and go.\nNothing's a sure thing.
These slot games…\nWin or lose, it's only by luck.

Hey!\pYou have better things to do,
champ in the making!\pCELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.\pShe is a user of GRASS-type
POKéMON, and at one with nature.\pShe might appear docile because of
her flower arranging…\pBut she's not one to be taken
lightly!
They offer rare POKéMON that can\nbe exchanged for your COINS.\pBut, I just can't seem to win!
Games are scary!\nIt's so easy to get hooked!
What's up?\nWant some COINS?
{PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the nice guy.
You have lots of COINS!
Darn! I need more COINS for the\nPOKéMON I want!
Hey, what? You're throwing me off!\nHere are some COINS, so shoo!
{PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the man.
You've got plenty of your own\nCOINS!
The trick is to watch the reels\nclosely.
I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!
Dang!
The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might\nbe discovered!\pI better tell BOSS!
Hey!\pA switch behind the poster!?\nLet's push it!
A COIN CASE is required…
